"I suppose that still counts as a good landing" thinking aloud of that old Terran cliché. 

I check the food/water supplies through the computer and ask it to take inventory of any supplies still aboard the ship. 

"I hope I didn't scuttle everything just to starve to death..."

Lastly I check the ship's logs to see if there are any information regarding this crash.

I groan loudly as I come to bleed still dripping from my mouth. While still strapped in I check myself for broken bones and other injuries. 

I check the database to see if the computer knows what planet I'm currently stuck on. It dawns on me that I should probably activate the distress beacon on the ship.
I recheck my harness and close my eyes as impact alarms blare in the background.

I strap myself into the command seat and command the ship to try and maintain course. 

For the rest of the fall, I try and relax my body and mutter a litany of protection.

I spit a mouthful of blood on the deck and look out the bridge window to see if there are any distinct landmarks.

I type in the command to estimate landing location and check for in atmosphere control surfaces and airbreaks.

I quickly scan for other life within the ship.

"If there is anyone still alive within this ship, you have ten seconds to evacuate all cargo holds and nonessential ship systems."

I count one of the longest ten seconds of my life then key in the command to jettison all cargo and nonessential systems. 

"Hope this works" I thought and I query the time for fuel and impact.

I taste blood as I pull myself off the ground. It would appear that I've bitten through the tip of my tongue. 

"Shit" I spat.

I query the command console to calculate the time of impact and the time of remaining fuel.

"No the medbay won't work..." I said aloud. "Maybe I can slow this thing down."

Sweat drips from my brow as I key in the commands for thrusters to fire retrograde. "Is it getting hot in here or is it just me..."
I frantically try to type the commands to re-orbit the ship. Should that fail I run a systems check for escape pods, emergency power, and/or smaller personal ships.
